title: Pandas Have a Meat-Eater's Gut, Yet Eat 84 Pounds of Bamboo
subject: giant panda

scenes.text: Pandas are classified as carnivores. So why do they spend all day eating bamboo?
Their gut is a meat-eater's: short, with bacteria like those in other carnivores.
Bamboo is low in nutrition, so a panda has to keep its digestive tract full.
It eats up to 84 pounds a day, around 38 kilograms.
That's twelve hours or more of chewing, with an extra wrist bone that works like a thumb.
A carnivore's body, running on a salad. Pandas still eat meat, fish, and eggs when they find them.

description:
Giant pandas have a carnivore's digestive system, yet live almost entirely on bamboo.
They eat up to 84 pounds a day and spend at least twelve hours eating.
Would you eat bamboo all day?
first_comment: Pandas still eat meat when they find it. Does that change how you see them?
